releaseNotes: Smart Life v0.11.93 makes WhatsApp Status media open directly inside Smart Life. A normal tap on a Status photo now opens a full-screen in-app viewer with pinch zoom and pan. A normal tap on a Status video now opens the built-in Smart Life video player with play/pause and scrubbing, so Android no longer shows the Open with chooser during normal use. Open externally remains available only from the 3-dot menu, together with Delete saved copy. The Status scan, Photos/Videos tabs, local persistence, Inbox placement and WhatsApp source-safety behavior remain unchanged.
